Great collection of latest novels and educational books too!!

One of the oldest book store in chembur now run by the 3rd generation. You will get all kinds of books here.. bestsellers, kids books, craft and creativity.. name it and u get it.

featured_reviews.name: Sadhan Deb
featured_reviews.review_text: It is a popular bookstore in chembur opposite Natraj theatre. They keep a variety of books. You can in fact order off-the-shelf academic books, and the proprietor would get it for you in a week or two. The proprietor has good knowledge in helping you select books for a gift, especially for children.

featured_reviews.name: Sriniwas Ghate
featured_reviews.review_text: It is a very nice book store. Most of the English classics are available here.They have a good collection of children's books too. Besides that they are known for providing textbooks of various competitive exams. You can place your order with them and within few days they will provide you with book of almost any examination. As far as the prices are concerned, they sell on MRP which is a lot more than some online marketplaces. They also have a good second hand book collection. Overall I would say it is a must visit place for any booklover especially in a place like Chembur!

featured_reviews.name: Shekhar Sherikar
featured_reviews.review_text: Been in business for a very long time, this bookstore is ideal if you are looking for useful books such as school text books, engineering text books, management text books, etc. Has a great collection of books for kids. Has a great collection of fiction books as well, but where it shines is the useful books. The proprietor is polite, helpful and knows how to treat customers well. Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Rocky Jagtiani
featured_reviews.review_text: Yes, the bookstore is very good. It has too many books ranging from the lowest to the highest level. They have even made their shop air conditioned now which is a good thing. The only problem is that you won't be able to stand and read books here for many hours as many book worms do. The shop is a bit cramped up but that won't matter if you just wanna buy a book.

featured_reviews.name: Sundarraj Kaushik
featured_reviews.review_text:
A good place to buy both academic and general books. Lots of books for kids.
Many fiction books are available too. Academic books seem to be limited to state board and CBSE.
Not many options for ICSE.
They also have a stock of second hand books.
The staff is friendly and well informed.
You can return most of the books after the academic year and get back half of the price if you maintain it in good shape.

featured_reviews.name: deeksha garg
featured_reviews.review_text:
A great book store hidden inside shivalaya market in Chembur. I went there on behalf of my husband to buy a book for a secret Santa gift. I'm not a fan of books but I liked the place, I felt like exploring the books.
Nice place and they're very polite and helpful in selecting books.

featured_reviews.name: Hrutesh Dodhia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dear BookBase Team,

I am writing to formally request a refund for my recent order.

I was charged ₹290 for delivery with a promised timeline of 15 days. However:

- The order was not delivered to my doorstep
- It was delivered to an incorrect location without my consent
- I was asked to collect it myself after multiple follow-ups
- Your customer support has now blocked me, preventing any resolution

This is unacceptable and does not meet the service promised at the time of purchase.

I request a full refund immediately. If this issue is not resolved at the earliest, I will be forced to escalate the matter through the National Consumer Helpline and consumer court.

Please treat this as urgent.

Sincerely,
Hrutesh Dodhia

featured_reviews.name: Sandhya Jaiswal
featured_reviews.review_text:
​I am extremely disappointed with the service here. This vendor is unreachable 90% of the time; they do not reply to messages and rarely answer the phone. I had to keep calling them once or twice a day for several days straight just to get a human on the line.
​Because they provide no updates, the burden is entirely on the customer to remember to follow up. When I finally reached someone to ask about a missing book from my April school set, the staff was incredibly rude. Instead of checking the order, the representative became defensive and dismissive, even accusing me of "raising my voice" after I expressed my frustration with their lack of response.
​They seem to think their time is valuable but the customer’s is not. It is clear they feel they don’t need to provide good service because they are the official vendors for a reputed school. If there were any other choice in the market, I would never shop here again.

featured_reviews.name: Manoj Nilve
featured_reviews.review_text:
The book prices are excessively high, and the service provided has been disappointing. They do not take responsibility for any issues. The school should shop considering Bookbase for their syllabus, even though they may be receiving substantial commissions.

My ticket (raised on bookbase site) has remained unresolved after three weeks. I contacted Bookbase, and their staff confirmed that my son would receive the missing book through the school. However, the book has not yet been received, and I find myself spending considerable time and effort on follow-up with Bookbase.

I am not sure how many more months Bookbase might take to deliver the missing book?
Additionally, I would appreciate the compensation or inconvenience charge that Bookbase will pay to me for the inconvenience they caused.

featured_reviews.name: Saniya Sanghvi
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Jolly Stationery has been a part of my life since childhood. From school projects and exam supplies to gifting and everyday essentials, this has always been our family's go-to place. The collection is amazing, prices are fair, and the owners are incredibly helpful and welcoming. It's rare to find a store that combines quality, variety, and such warm service. So many memories are attached to this place, and I still prefer coming here over ordering online. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.review_text: We’ve had a wonderful experience with Jolly Stationary and Xerox. They always deliver printouts on time and exactly as per our school requirements. Their service is reliable, efficient, and very convenient. Highly recommended for all printing and stationary needs..!

featured_reviews.name: Keshab Chandra Goswami
featured_reviews.review_text:
Jolly Stationery & Xerox continues to uphold its legacy of excellent customer service under the management of Kalpesh and Sonam. The shop remains a trusted one-stop destination for all stationery needs, always well-stocked to serve the local community efficiently.

They have maintained their expertise in sourcing school books, catering to the requirements of nearby schools and colleges. If a book isn't readily available, they go the extra mile to arrange it within a week.

Their proficiency in ID card printing is remarkable. They were among the first to offer Aadhar and Universal Pass printing, and with their high-quality printers, they handle most customizations seamlessly.

While the shop deeply misses the presence of its empathetic mother, her values of customer care and honesty continue to reflect in the way Kalpesh and Sonam run the business. Their dedication ensures that every visit remains a pleasant experience.
